header.name: Meat_plant
header.full_name: Integrated pork plant: slaughtering, cutting and cooked sausages
header.authors_and_contributors: Daniel Flórez-Orrego, Meire Ribeiro Domingos, Pullah Bhatnagar, Oktay Boztas, EPFL IPESE research group
header.description: Integrated pork plant: slaughtering, carcass chilling, cutting and deboning, and cooked-sausage production, with the hot, warm and tap water networks of the site and 14 thermal streams.

units.unit_description: This unit slaughters pigs and processes 1 t/h of hot carcass: stunning and bleeding, scalding and dehairing, singeing and dressing, carcass chilling, cutting and deboning in chilled rooms, and a cooked-sausage line (mixing and filling, cooking with direct steam, showering and chilling), with chilled and frozen storage. It includes the hot, warm and tap water networks of the site.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes live pigs, ice and water for the batter, and electricity, and delivers fresh cuts, cooked sausages, blood, offal, bones and fat, and the vapour of the cooking. The flows close at 1,332.1 kg/h in and out. The water networks are utility media and are not connectors.

units.heat_streams_description: 6 cold and 8 hot streams, time-averaged over the operating hours; batch steps (cooking, cleaning) are given by their average load. The singeing oven (C1) is a direct-fired duty. Streams with a 1 K span are near-isothermal duties: the scalding tank, the steam injection and the room air. H4 to H8 are refrigeration demands at the product or room-air temperature.
